units.source_text: 从这时候起，老师对我明显地疏远了。

en.t: From that time on, the teacher clearly grew distant from me.

units.source_text: 这就是我盼望的演变结果，是我希望看到的证迹，也是我的一种胜利。

en.t: This was the outcome of the change I had longed for, the evidence I had hoped to see, and also a kind of victory for me.

units.source_text: 而且，要获得这种胜利，只需偷懒就足够了。

en.t: Moreover, to gain this victory, it was enough simply to be lazy.
